On my way home from the Medical Affairs Excellence Summit in Brussels and still processing everything. What I really appreciated wasn’t just the content (which was great), but the discussions around it. A lot of honest conversations about where Medical Affairs is today and where it’s heading. Some ideas I am reflecting on: * The role of Medical Affairs is clearly expanding and expectations are changing fast * RWE is becoming more and more central in how we think and act * Collaboration sounds obvious, but in practice it’s still one of the biggest challenges (and opportunities) * And honestly, some of the most valuable moments were the informal chats in between sessions Also, it was great to meet so many people who are genuinely passionate about what they do. Thanks to everyone I connected with, looking forward to continuing the conversations. #MedicalAffairs #Pharma #MedicalAffairsLeadership #MedicalAffairsCommunity #MedicalAffairsExcellenceSummit #WörwagPharma

🚀 Great session yesterday at KPMG Italy with Italian Tech Alliance on how to value early‑stage startups. A few sharp takeaways: • Price ≠ Value - a core principle founders often overlook. • Different methods for different stages - from VC Method to First Chicago and Berkus. • Milestones drive valuation - every step reduces risk and increases expected value. • Team quality is the real multiplier in early phases. Thanks to Alessandro Ariani and Matteo Lugli for the clarity and frameworks shared, and to Italian Tech Alliance for bringing the ecosystem together. Gennaro A. We are launching the Wörwag Pharma Health Academy — a new global webinar series for physicians and pharmacists. 🧑‍⚕️​​⚕️ The series focuses on biofactors, particularly micronutrients, their physiological roles, and their relevance for health and disease, including the often‑overlooked impact of micronutrient deficiencies. We are excited to kick off the series with our first webinar: 🚀 Healthcare Needs a Trip to Mars: How AI is Changing Medicine 📅 April 28, 2026 | 6:00 PM CEST | Language: English Artificial intelligence is already reshaping how medical data is analyzed and how knowledge is applied in practice. In this session, Bertalan Meskó, MD, PhD , the Medical Futurist, explores the future of healthcare and digital health technologies, arguing that we need a system capable of keeping even an astronaut alive on Mars — and rethinking how care is delivered around the patient. Building on this future-focused perspective, Prof. Dr. Klaus Kisters brings us back to everyday practice, highlighting the crucial yet often overlooked role of magnesium as a “forgotten electrolyte” in modern medicine. 👉Register now: https://lnkd.in/dCEpfKbq

As WhiteLab Genomics enters its next phase of growth, I’m excited to step into the role of Chief Operating Officer. Two years ago, I joined as Chief of Staff at a moment when the company was scaling fast — and needed stronger alignment, clearer governance, and more structured execution. Since then, my focus has been simple: connect strategy, science, and execution — and help build the foundations that allow a complex organization to move forward with clarity. It’s been an intense and rewarding journey, helping translate ambition into coordinated execution as WhiteLab expanded its scientific, technological, and commercial footprint. Today, the challenge evolves. We’re moving from building the operating backbone to scaling it — ensuring our execution keeps pace with our scientific ambition, across client programs, platform development, and bio-validation. ➡️ One key takeaway from this journey: scaling is not just about vision — it’s about executing consistently as complexity grows. I’m deeply grateful to my co-founders David Del Bourgo and Julien Cottineau — for the conviction to bring me back into an operating role at a pivotal moment, and the clarity to evolve our leadership for this next phase: focused on delivery, execution excellence, and scale. That ability to adapt leadership to what the company needs next is rare — and a big part of what makes WhiteLab such a strong place to build. And to the team: I’m excited to continue this journey together, as we work to bring transformative therapies closer to the patients who need them 💪 Onward 🚀
